reason: A Windows command-line launcher that automates installation, startup, browser opening, status monitoring, stopping, upgrading, and uninstallation of a local DeepSeek Harness web service.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 上通过 deepseek 命令安装、启动、管理和升级本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务的命令行启动器。
summaries.en: A Windows command-line launcher for installing, starting, managing, upgrading, and uninstalling a local DeepSeek Harness web service.

capabilities: Starts and stops a local DeepSeek Harness service
Downloads and prepares Node.js/npm runtime dependencies
Modifies the user PATH to register the deepseek command
Opens a local web interface in the browser
Checks versions and performs runtime upgrades
Removes launcher files, logs, shortcuts, and runtime data during full uninstall
